component.name: Mosaic
component.summary: Run Android apps natively alongside desktop programs
Запуск Android-приложений рядом с обычными программами

description.p: Mosaic runs Android apps as native Linux processes. There is no Android system to boot and no container to manage: an installed app is an ordinary desktop application that opens a real Wayland window, and its data lives under its own system user.

The Android API surface, framework services, Binder and the hardware abstraction layer are translated to host equivalents, with AOSP's ART and Bionic reused as host-native libraries rather than reimplemented.
